description:
## 1.1.0

### New

* **Fix speed drops**: stops Waze from showing 0 km/h for a moment while driving on phones without Google Play services.

### Changes

* The extension no longer bundles the Kotlin standard library (2.2 MB smaller, no clash with Waze's own copy).

> ⚠️ Written entirely by AI. Fix speed drops has not been tested in a real car yet.
